config.json of the other dense Qwen3.5 checkpoints, fetched 2026-11-10 from
https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/main/config.json (file name = the
repository, with "/" written "__"):

  Qwen__Qwen3.5-0.8B.json, Qwen__Qwen3.5-2B.json, Qwen__Qwen3.5-9B.json

They have the architecture of the Qwen3.5-4B / 27B in ../hf_configs and are
used by extra/tests/qwen3_5.py alongside those two. They are kept apart
because ../hf_configs holds exactly the checkpoints of
knowledgematrix.models.hub.SUPPORTED_LLMS.

The config.json of Qwen3.5-{0.8B,4B,9B}-Base was compared with that of the
non-Base repository and is identical.

Other Qwen3.5 repositories hold different networks, which the loader
refuses. Checked on one repository of each kind: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B is a
mixture-of-experts model (model_type qwen3_5_moe, text model_type
qwen3_5_moe_text), Qwen3.5-27B-FP8 is quantized (quantization_config with
quant_method fp8).
